provenance: Marine protected areas from EMODnet Human Activities, which republishes the EUROPEAN EXTRACT of the World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA). Rasterised to a 0.5 degree grid at build time by scripts/build-protected-areas.mjs. This is NOT global WDPA: all features fall within the dataExtent below, and outside that extent the absence of a marked cell means NO DATA, never 'no protected areas'.
resolutionCaveat: A 0.1 degree cell is about 11 km. 702 of 826 protected areas produce at least one cell; 7500 of 8254 individual polygon parts are smaller than one cell and resolve to at most a single cell. Extent is approximate at this resolution and must never be presented as a legal boundary -- it answers 'is this route near protected water', not 'is this point inside a protected area'.
